entries.title: Pure Silver Ingot
entries.body:
# Pure Silver Ingot

## Effect
Pure Silver Ingots produce a refined metal that channels Light with exceptional clarity. It excels in purification, protection, and revealing hidden or corrupted forces.

---
## Appearance
Pure Silver Ingots are smooth and highly refined, with a bright, mirror-like surface that reflects light cleanly and evenly. Unlike other metals, the reflection appears crisp and undistorted, giving it a sense of clarity and purity.

A faint, steady glow lingers along the surface, most noticeable in darkness, as if the metal itself carries a quiet, internal light.

---
## Crafting Use
- Holy weapons  
- Radiant armor  
- Anti-corruption tools  
- Divine or celestial equipment  

---

## Material Traits
- Lightweight and highly refined  
- Maintains purity under normal conditions  
- Slightly softer than combat-focused metals  
- Reacts strongly to corruption and shadow  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Light** magic  
- Enhances:
  - Purification  
  - Illumination  
  - Anti-corruption effects  
- Weak synergy with Dark-aligned enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +2 Damage Modifier  
- +3 Armor Modifier  
- Favours defensive, support, and anti-corruption builds  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires: 4x [[Pure Silver Ore]]

---

## Quote
*"Where it touches, truth is laid bare."*

entries.title: Quicksilver Ingot
entries.body:
# Quicksilver Ingot

## Effect
Quicksilver Ingots produce a highly adaptive metal that enhances speed, precision, and responsiveness. It reacts to both physical movement and magical input, making it ideal for fluid combat styles.

---
## Appearance
Quicksilver Ingots appear as perfectly refined bars of reflective metal, their surface constantly shifting with subtle waves and distortions. Despite being solid, they give the impression of barely contained motion.

When held, the metal seems to “adjust” slightly, redistributing its form in response to grip, movement, or intent.

---
## Crafting Use
- Adaptive weapons  
- Flexible armor  
- Arcane tools  
- Precision-based equipment  

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely lightweight  
- Responds instantly to movement and force  
- Maintains structure despite fluid-like behavior  
- Less stable under prolonged heavy impact  

---

## Alloy Use
- Can be used in adaptive alloy systems (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Water** and **Air** essences  
- Enhances:
  - Speed-based enchantments  
  - Reactive effects  
  - Movement and evasion abilities  
- Supports enchantments that change during combat  

---

## Combat Integration
- +3 Damage Modifier  
- +2 Armor Modifier  
- Favours speed, agility, and reactive combat builds  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires: 4x [[Quicksilver Ore]]

---

## Quote
*"Strike before thought — and it will follow."*

entries.title: Tungsten Ingot
entries.body:
# Tungsten Ingot

## Effect
Tungsten Ingots produce an extremely dense and durable metal that excels in defensive applications and heavy weapon construction. It sacrifices speed and flexibility for raw endurance and impact force.

---
## Appearance
Tungsten Ingots are thick, dark grey bars with a matte, almost stone-like finish. They lack the reflective quality of most metals, instead appearing solid and weighty, with sharp, clean edges that emphasise their density.

When handled, the ingot gives the impression of extreme weight and immovability, as if the material resists being lifted or shifted, reinforcing its nature as a metal built for endurance rather than elegance.

---
## Crafting Use
- Heavy armor  
- Warhammers and blunt weapons  
- Reinforced structures  
- Defensive equipment  

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely heavy and dense  
- Exceptional resistance to heat and pressure  
- Difficult to shape once refined  
- Maintains integrity under extreme stress  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Very low magical compatibility  
- Better suited for passive durability than active enchantments  
- Resistant to magical degradation  

---

## Combat Integration
- +2 Damage Modifier  
- +4 Armor Modifier  
- Favours tank and heavy combat builds  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires: 4x [[Tungsten Ore]]

---

## Quote
*"The mountain does not strike — it outlasts."*

entries.title: Abyssal Steel Ingot
entries.body:
# Abyssal Steel Ingot

## Effect
Abyssal Steel is a void-forged alloy created by infusing High Steel with Abyssal essence. It exerts immense pressure on its surroundings, suppressing energy and overwhelming resistance through sheer density and presence.

---

## Appearance
Abyssal Steel appears as a deep, lightless metal with a faint blue-black tone. Its surface absorbs light completely, with subtle ripples forming across it like a calm, endless ocean.

When observed closely, the metal seems to distort depth, as if it extends far beyond its physical form.

---

## Lore
Forged within the depths of the Abyssal Realm, Abyssal Steel is shaped under immense pressure where energy collapses inward rather than radiating outward.

It is said that each ingot carries the weight of the abyss itself, making it one of the most oppressive materials known.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely dense and pressure-heavy  
- Suppresses surrounding energy  
- Maintains integrity under extreme force  
- Difficult to shape and transport  

---

## Alloy Composition
- High Steel  
- Abyssal Essence  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Abyssal** 
- Enhances:
  - Suppression effects  
  - Control and restriction  
  - Anti-energy interactions  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +4 Armor Modifier  
- Favours control, suppression, and heavy combat builds  

---

## Special Interaction
- Reduces effectiveness of Light-aligned effects  
- Performs best against high-energy or magic-heavy opponents  
- Creates a “pressure” effect in close combat  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires High Steel  
- Requires Abyssal Essence  
- Must be forged within the **Abyssal Realm**

---

## Quote
*"It does not strike — it crushes everything beneath it."*

entries.title: Arricallium Ingot
entries.body:
# Arricallium Ingot

## Effect
Arricallium Ingots produce a refined metal that excels at conducting and amplifying magical energy, making it ideal for spellcasting equipment and magical constructs.

---

## Appearance
Arricallium Ingots are smooth, metallic bars with faint glowing veins running beneath the surface. These veins shift slowly, as if energy is continuously flowing through the metal.

The surface emits a subtle hum when held near magical sources.

---

## Lore
Once refined, Arricallium becomes one of the most valuable materials for magical construction. It is widely used in advanced spellcasting tools, arcane conduits, and high-tier enchanted equipment.

Despite its stability, improper handling during forging can result in violent energy discharge.

---

## Material Traits
- Excellent magical conductivity  
- Maintains stability under sustained magical use  
- Lightweight compared to other Epic metals  
- Sensitive to overload if improperly used  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Air** and **Fire**  
- Enhances:
  - Spellcasting  
  - Channeling  
  - Energy-based enchantments  
- Poor synergy with purely physical builds  

---

## Combat Integration
- +4 Damage Modifier  
- +3 Armor Modifier  
- Favours caster, hybrid, and magic-focused builds  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Arricallium Ore]]  
- Requires energy-stabilised forge  

---

## Quote
*"Power flows through it — not into it."*

entries.title: Celestial Steel Ingot
entries.body:
# Celestial Steel Ingot

## Effect
Celestial Steel is a refined divine alloy created by infusing High Steel with concentrated celestial essence. It represents a perfected form of Light-aligned material, offering superior protection, clarity, and stability.

---

## Appearance
Celestial Steel appears as a luminous silver-white metal with faint golden undertones. Soft currents of light move beneath its surface, giving it a constant, calm radiance.

The metal reflects light cleanly without glare, creating a sense of clarity and purity rather than brilliance.

---

## Lore
Celestial Steel is the evolution of Celestial Bronze, forged by combining High Steel with celestial essence within divine forges. This process refines the metal beyond mortal limits, creating a material capable of channeling higher-order Light.

It is often reserved for relic weapons, divine armor, and artifacts tied to celestial forces or higher beings.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely stable under magical influence  
- Resistant to corruption and shadow  
- Maintains clarity and structure under stress  
- Balanced strength and refinement  

---

## Alloy Composition
- High Steel  
- Celestial Essence  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Light**  
- Enhances:
  - Purification  
  - Defensive enchantments  
  - Clarity and control of magic  
- Weak interaction with Dark-aligned effects  

---

## Combat Integration
- +4 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours defensive, balanced, and Light-aligned builds  

---

## Special Interaction
- Increased effectiveness against **Infernal-aligned beings**  
- Reduced effectiveness against Celestial-aligned entities  
- Naturally resists corruption and curse effects  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires High Steel  
- Requires Celestial Essence  
- Must be forged within the **Celestial Realm**

---

## Quote
*"Where bronze carries light — steel becomes it."*

entries.title: Dark Stone Ingot
entries.body:
# Dark Stone Ingot

## Effect
Dark Stone is an evolved form of Moonstone, shaped through prolonged exposure to Dark and Death-aligned environments. It enhances suppression, decay, and control over opposing forces.

---

## Appearance
Dark Stone appears as a deep black-grey metal with faint, dim internal movement beneath its surface. Unlike Ebony, it does not absorb all light, but instead dulls it, creating a muted, twilight-like sheen.

---

## Lore
Dark Stone forms when Moonstone is exposed to environments saturated with darkness and death energy. This transformation strips away balance, leaving a material aligned with suppression and control.

---

## Material Traits
- Absorbs and dampens energy  
- Stable under shadow and death influence  
- Suppresses surrounding magical presence  
- Performs best in low-light or dark environments  

---

## Evolution Path
- Origin: [[Moonstone Ingot]]  
- Requires Dark-aligned refinement process  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Dark** and **Death**  
- Enhances:
  - Suppression effects  
  - Debuffs and decay  
  - Control-based abilities  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +3 Armor Modifier  
- Favours control, suppression, and dark-aligned builds  

---

## Quote
*"Balance was a lie — this is what remains."*

entries.title: Duranium Ingot
entries.body:
# Duranium Ingot

## Effect
Duranium Ingots produce a highly resilient metal that absorbs, stabilises, and redistributes force. It adapts to repeated stress, making it one of the most reliable defensive materials available.

---

## Appearance
Duranium Ingots are dense, dark grey bars with subtle internal movement beneath the surface. When struck, faint waves ripple across the metal before settling.

---

## Lore
Once refined, Duranium becomes a cornerstone material for defensive equipment and high-end constructs. Its ability to adapt to stress makes it invaluable in prolonged combat and high-impact environments.

---

## Material Traits
- Absorbs and redistributes force  
- Adapts to repeated impact  
- Extremely durable under sustained stress  
- Maintains structural integrity under extreme conditions  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Earth** and **Air**  
- Enhances:
  - Defensive enchantments  
  - Stability and reinforcement  
  - Impact resistance  

---

## Combat Integration
- +4 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours defensive, adaptive, and tank builds  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Duranium Ore]]  
- Requires high-energy forge  

---

## Quote
*"It learns every strike — and answers with silence."*

entries.title: Ebony Ingot
entries.body:
# Ebony Ingot

## Effect
Ebony Ingots produce a dense shadow-infused metal that absorbs light, sound, and ambient energy. It enhances overwhelming presence and oppressive force, making it ideal for heavy, unstoppable combat styles.

---

## Appearance
Ebony Ingots are deep black with a matte surface that consumes surrounding light. The metal appears unnaturally dense, with faint violet undertones shifting beneath its surface when exposed to energy.

Even when still, it gives the impression of weight and pressure, as if the space around it is being pulled inward.

---

## Lore
Ebony forms in regions where death energy and shadow accumulate over immense periods of time. Once refined, it becomes one of the densest materials known, carrying the weight of absorbed energy within its structure.

It is often used in weapons and armor designed to dominate through presence rather than speed.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely dense and heavy  
- Absorbs light and ambient energy  
- Dampens sound and magical signatures  
- Maintains integrity under extreme pressure  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Dark** and **Death**  
- Enhances:
  - Suppression effects  
  - Life-drain and decay  
  - Presence-based abilities  
- Weak against Light-aligned enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +4 Armor Modifier  
- Favours heavy, oppressive, and shadow-dominant builds  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Ebony Ore]]  
- Requires shadow-aligned forge  

---

## Quote
*"It does not chase — it waits, and the world comes to it."*

entries.title: Ice Glass Ingot
entries.body:
# Ice Glass Ingot

## Effect
Ice Glass is a refined crystalline alloy formed by fusing powdered ice crystals with Aluminum through a controlled cold-forging process. It produces a material that excels in precision and freezing control, allowing it to deliver sharp, controlled strikes that hinder movement.

---

## Appearance
Ice Glass Ingots are translucent with a pale blue tint, resembling perfectly frozen crystal. Light refracts softly through the material, creating layered frost-like patterns within.

The surface appears smooth and cold, with faint mist forming around it in warmer environments.

---

## Lore
Ice Glass is an evolution of the Glass forging process, replacing Astryx Sand with powdered ice crystals sourced from extreme cold regions or magically frozen environments.

Unlike standard Glass, Ice Glass must be forged under controlled cold conditions. Heat destabilises the material, making its creation both rare and difficult.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely sharp and precise  
- Lightweight and responsive  
- Structurally stable in cold environments  
- Brittle under heat and heavy impact  

---

## Alloy Composition
- Powdered Ice Crystal  
- Aluminum Ingot  
- Controlled cold-forging process  

---

## Enchantment Use
- High affinity with **Water** and **Air**  
- Enhances:
  - Freezing effects  
  - Movement control  
  - Precision-based abilities  
- Weak under Fire-aligned enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +2 Armor Modifier  
- Favours precision, control, and frost-based combat builds  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires Powdered Ice Crystal  
- Requires Aluminum Ingot  
- Requires cold-forging environment or frost-aligned forge  

---

## Quote
*"It does not shatter — it stops everything before it can move."*

entries.title: Infernal Steel Ingot
entries.body:
# Infernal Steel Ingot

## Effect
Infernal Steel is a refined alloy created by infusing High Steel with concentrated infernal essence. It is designed for destruction, amplifying offensive power while maintaining the strength needed for prolonged combat.

---

## Appearance
Infernal Steel appears as a dark, red-black metal with faint ember-like veins glowing beneath its surface. These veins pulse slowly, giving the impression of contained heat and controlled fury.

When exposed to combat or stress, the glow intensifies slightly, as if the metal is responding to conflict.

---

## Lore
Infernal Steel is the evolution of Infernal Bronze, forged within infernal forges where heat and destructive energy are refined into controlled power.

Unlike raw infernal materials, Infernal Steel is shaped and stabilised, allowing it to be wielded effectively without immediately overwhelming its user.

It is often used for weapons and armor designed for conquest, domination, and battlefield superiority.

---

## Material Traits
- Highly resistant to heat and destructive forces  
- Channels aggressive energy efficiently  
- Maintains structure under prolonged combat stress  
- Slightly volatile under extreme magical strain  

---

## Alloy Composition
- High Steel  
- Infernal Essence  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Fire** and **Dark**  
- Enhances:
  - Offensive enchantments  
  - Burn and damage-over-time effects  
  - Aggressive combat abilities  
- Less effective for defensive or purification effects  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +3 Armor Modifier  
- Favours aggressive, high-damage combat builds  

---

## Special Interaction
- Increased effectiveness against **Celestial-aligned beings**  
- Reduced effectiveness against Infernal-aligned entities  
- Performs best during sustained combat and high-pressure situations  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires High Steel  
- Requires Infernal Essence  
- Must be forged within the **Infernal Realm**

---

## Quote
*"Where steel is tempered — this is unleashed."*

entries.title: Light Stone Ingot
entries.body:
# Light Stone Ingot

## Effect
Light Stone is an evolved form of Moonstone, refined under continuous exposure to Light. It amplifies clarity, protection, and purification, making it ideal for defensive and support-oriented equipment.

---

## Appearance
Light Stone appears as a luminous, pale metal with a soft white and silver glow. Its surface reflects light cleanly, with faint internal radiance that pulses gently beneath it.

---

## Lore
Light Stone forms when Moonstone is exposed to intense Light-aligned environments over extended periods. This process removes its dual nature, leaving behind a purified material aligned entirely with Light.

---

## Material Traits
- Highly stable under magical conditions  
- Resistant to corruption and decay  
- Maintains structural clarity under stress  
- Performs best in Light-aligned environments  

---

## Evolution Path
- Origin: [[Moonstone Ingot]]  
- Requires Light-aligned refinement process  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Light**  
- Enhances:
  - Purification  
  - Defensive effects  
  - Healing-adjacent enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +4 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours defensive, support, and Light-aligned builds  

---

## Quote
*"What was once balanced now stands unwavering."*

entries.title: Titan Steel Ingot
entries.body:
# Titan Steel Ingot

## Effect
Titan Steel is a legendary alloy forged by infusing High Steel with the blood of the Titan race. It embodies unmatched physical strength and resilience, allowing it to endure and deliver immense force without compromise.

---

## Appearance
Titan Steel appears as a dense, dark metallic alloy with faint, slow-moving veins of deep amber or gold running beneath its surface. These veins pulse subtly, as if carrying the lingering essence of something immense and ancient.

The metal feels impossibly heavy for its size, and even at rest, it gives the impression of contained force.

---

## Lore
Titan Steel is not merely forged — it is created through sacrifice.

The process requires High Steel to be infused with the essence of a Titan, a race of lesser gods whose existence is rare and dwindling. Because of this, Titan Steel is one of the most difficult materials to create, and its existence is tightly controlled across the realms.

Many believe that each ingot retains a fragment of the Titan’s will, granting it strength beyond mortal materials.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely dense and heavy  
- Unmatched resistance to physical force  
- Maintains integrity under extreme stress  
- Difficult to shape and nearly impossible to break  

---

## Alloy Composition
- High Steel  
- Titan Blood (or preserved Titan essence)  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Moderate affinity with **Earth**  
- Enhances:
  - Strength-based effects  
  - Impact and force  
  - Defensive enchantments  
- Poor synergy with delicate or precision-based enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours heavy, strength-based, and frontline builds  

---

## Special Interaction
- Increased effectiveness against massive or high-tier creatures  
- Cannot be easily broken, sundered, or degraded  
- Performs best under direct physical confrontation  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires High Steel  
- Requires Titan Blood or Titan essence  
- Requires advanced or divine-grade forge  

---

## Quote
*"It does not yield — it reminds the world what strength truly is."*

entries.title: Adamantium Ingot
entries.body:
# Adamantium Ingot

## Effect
Adamantium is one of the hardest known metals in existence. It is capable of enduring overwhelming force without deforming, breaking, or degrading, making it the ultimate material for defensive structures and high-impact weaponry.

---

## Appearance
Adamantium Ingots are dark metallic grey with a dense, stone-like finish. Unlike polished metals, Adamantium absorbs light rather than reflecting it brightly, giving it a heavy and immovable presence.

When struck, it emits a deep resonant tone instead of a metallic clang.

---

## Lore
Forged from ore created under impossible pressure, Adamantium became known as the “final forge metal” among ancient master smiths. Entire civilizations built fortresses, war machines, and relic armor from it, believing no mortal force could destroy it.

Many ancient Adamantium structures still remain long after the civilizations that created them have vanished.

---

## Material Traits
- Near-indestructible under physical stress  
- Resistant to corrosion, decay, and environmental damage  
- Extremely difficult to forge and shape  
- Maintains structural integrity under immense impact  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Earth**  
- Enhances:
  - Reinforcement enchantments  
  - Stability and defensive effects  
  - Force resistance  
- Less effective for precision or high-energy enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours tank, siege, and defensive builds  

---

## Special Interaction
- Extremely resistant to physical degradation  
- Performs best under sustained impact and prolonged combat  
- Difficult for weaker materials to damage directly  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Adamantium Ore]]  
- Requires divine-grade, deep-earth, or legendary forge conditions  

---

## Quote
*"The gods forged mountains; we forged what could endure them."*

entries.title: Dragon Glass Ingot
entries.body:
# Dragon Glass Ingot

## Effect
Dragon Glass is a draconic crystalline alloy created through an advanced variation of the Glass forging process. By combining Pyraxx Sand and Aluminum under intense dragonfire, smiths produce a material infused with primal heat and destructive draconic energy.

The result is a highly aggressive alloy capable of channeling immense thermal force while maintaining razor-sharp precision.

---

## Appearance
Dragon Glass appears as jet-black crystalline metal threaded with glowing crimson and ember-orange veins beneath its surface. These veins pulse faintly like molten magma trapped within dark obsidian.

When exposed to heat, combat, or draconic presence, the internal glow intensifies and spreads throughout the material.

The surface reflects light unevenly, giving the metal a living and volatile appearance.

---

## Lore
Dragon Glass was developed after ancient forge masters discovered that certain volcanic sands reacted violently when exposed to dragonfire. Through repeated experimentation, they refined the Glass forging process into something far more dangerous.

Using Pyraxx Sand — a volcanic crystalline sand formed near dragon nesting grounds and magma fissures — smiths learned to create a material capable of carrying lingering draconic resonance.

Because true dragonfire is required during forging, Dragon Glass remains one of the rarest and most dangerous alloys in existence.

---

## Material Traits
- Channels heat and aggressive energy efficiently  
- Extremely sharp and destructive  
- Resonates with draconic energy  
- Stable under extreme heat  
- Becomes volatile under conflicting elemental influence  

---

## Alloy Composition
- Pyraxx Sand  
- Aluminum Ingot  
- Dragonfire forging process  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Fire** and **Earth**  
- Enhances:
  - Flame effects  
  - Aggressive enchantments  
  - Destructive elemental abilities  
- Weak interaction with Water-aligned enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +3 Armor Modifier  
- Favours aggressive, spellblade, and draconic combat styles  

---

## Special Interaction
- Resonates strongly near dragons or draconic creatures  
- Performs best in high-heat environments  
- Can slowly absorb ambient fire or draconic energy over time  
- Dragonfire exposure can temporarily strengthen the material  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires Pyraxx Sand  
- Requires Aluminum Ingot  
- Must be forged using dragonfire or within a dragonfire forge  

---

## Quote
*"Glass was refined by flame — Dragon Glass was claimed by it."*

entries.title: Elementium Ingot
entries.body:
# Elementium Ingot

## Effect
Elementium is a harmonised elemental metal capable of conducting and stabilising multiple elemental energies simultaneously. It naturally adapts to the elemental affinity of its wielder while maintaining perfect internal balance.

---

## Appearance
Elementium Ingots possess a smooth metallic surface threaded with constantly shifting elemental colouration. Waves of ember-gold, deep ocean blue, storm silver, and emerald-green move beneath the surface like flowing energy.

The metal subtly changes depending on nearby elemental forces.

---

## Lore
Elementium is considered one of the rarest and most refined elemental materials in existence. Ancient records claim it was first forged within the Astral Crucible by the god-smith Auralon the Starborn.

Unlike most materials, Elementium does not force elemental power into shape — it allows the elements to coexist naturally within its structure.

Because of this, many believe the metal itself possesses a primitive awareness of balance and harmony.

---

## Material Traits
- Conducts multiple elemental energies simultaneously  
- Maintains perfect elemental stability  
- Slowly repairs minor magical instability through exposure to mana  
- Adapts naturally to surrounding elemental environments  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with:
  - Fire
  - Water
  - Earth
  - Air
  - Light
  - Dark
  - Life
  - Death
- Enhances:
  - Multi-element enchantments  
  - Mana stability  
  - Elemental channeling  
- Difficult to corrupt or destabilise  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours elementalists, hybrid casters, and high-tier magical builds  

---

## Special Interaction
- Adapts naturally to the wielder’s dominant elemental affinity  
- Performs exceptionally well under balanced elemental conditions  
- Can stabilise conflicting elemental enchantments more effectively than most materials  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Elementium Ore]]  
- Requires astral forge or elemental convergence conditions  

---

## Quote
*"Elementium does not command the elements — it unites them."*

entries.title: Meteorite Ingot
entries.body:
# Meteorite Ingot

## Effect
Meteorite Ingots produce a dense celestial metal capable of withstanding immense force and delivering devastating impact power.

The metal retains traces of cosmic compression and atmospheric heat, giving it exceptional strength and resilience.

---

## Appearance
Meteorite Ingots are dark grey-black with scorched crimson streaks and faint silver inclusions beneath the surface.

The metal carries a rough, star-forged appearance rather than the polished finish of refined alloys.

---

## Lore
Meteorite metal has been prized throughout history due to its rarity and celestial origins. Ancient smiths believed weapons forged from fallen stars carried the will of the heavens themselves.

Because impact sites are uncommon and heavily contested, true Meteorite metal remains rare even among advanced civilizations.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely impact-resistant  
- Retains celestial compression properties  
- Highly resistant to heat and pressure  
- Difficult to forge and refine  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Fire** and **Earth**  
- Enhances:
  - Force-based enchantments  
  - Impact effects  
  - Heat-related abilities  
- Less effective for delicate magical refinement  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +3 Armor Modifier  
- Favours heavy weapons, siege equipment, and impact-focused combat styles  

---

## Special Interaction
- Performs exceptionally well under high-impact stress  
- Retains heat longer than most metals  
- Resistant to structural cracking under force  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Meteorite Ore]]  
- Requires starforge or extreme-temperature forge conditions  

---

## Quote
*"A weapon from the stars carries the weight of its fall."*

entries.title: Necronium Ingot
entries.body:
# Necronium Ingot

## Effect
Necronium is a death-infused metal that directly interacts with living essence. When brought into contact with living beings, it drains vitality and converts it into necrotic energy.

---

## Appearance
Necronium Ingots are dark and muted, with faint grey-violet tones beneath a smooth surface. The metal appears unnaturally still, with subtle distortions resembling drifting ash or fading smoke.

When held by a living creature, the air around it feels colder and heavier.

---

## Lore
Once refined, Necronium becomes one of the most dangerous materials in existence. It is not forged from the earth, but from accumulated death itself.

Weapons and armor made from Necronium are feared across realms, as they do not simply harm — they erode life directly.

---

## Material Traits
- Reacts to living essence  
- Drains vitality on sustained contact  
- Stable under necrotic influence  
- Weak under intense Light-aligned energy  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Death**  
- Enhances:
  - Life-drain  
  - Decay  
  - Curse-based effects  
- Poor interaction with Light-aligned enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +3 Armor Modifier  
- Favours drain, sustain, and death-based builds  

---

## Special Interaction
- Damages **living targets on successful strikes or sustained contact**  
- No effect on undead or non-living entities  
- Prolonged exposure weakens living creatures  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Necronium Ore]]  
- Requires necrotic-aligned forge  
- Forms in death-saturated environments or Death-aligned realms  

---

## Quote
*"It does not strike life — it removes it."*

entries.title: Red Duranium Ingot
entries.body:
# Red Duranium Ingot

## Effect
Red Duranium is a corrupted evolution of Duranium, forged through exposure to immense heat, bloodshed, and violent energy. It retains the adaptive resilience of Duranium while converting absorbed force into aggression, regeneration, and destructive output.

---

## Appearance
Red Duranium Ingots are dark metallic bars streaked with deep crimson veins that pulse slowly beneath the surface like molten blood.

The metal radiates faint heat constantly, and during combat or stress, the glow intensifies as energy moves throughout the ingot.

When struck, the metal emits a deep resonance rather than a metallic clang.

---

## Lore
Red Duranium is found only within the Zahram Peaks, surrounded by the deadly Rahzakar Dunes.

Over countless years, Duranium exposed to the extreme conditions of the region mutates into a far more dangerous material. The constant cycle of death, predation, and heat saturates the ore with violent energy, transforming it into a living, reactive alloy.

Weapons and armor forged from Red Duranium are feared for their hunger — growing stronger through prolonged combat and sustained conflict.

---

## Material Traits
- Converts absorbed force into offensive energy  
- Regenerates minor structural damage through heat and vitality  
- Extremely resistant to physical and fire-based damage  
- Can destabilise weaker wielders over time  
- Performs best under sustained combat pressure  

---

## Variant Transformation
- Originates from: [[Duranium Ingot]]  
- Requires:
  - Red Duranium Ore  
  - High-temperature forge  
  - Controlled refinement process  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Fire** and **Death**  
- Enhances:
  - Burn effects  
  - Life-drain  
  - Aggressive combat enchantments  
- Less stable with defensive or purification enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +4 Armor Modifier  
- Favours aggressive, sustain, and high-risk combat builds  

---

## Special Interaction
- Becomes more effective during prolonged combat  
- Regenerates minor damage slowly over time  
- Reacts aggressively to nearby violence or bloodshed  
- May influence emotionally unstable wielders  

---

## Acquisition
- Found only within the Zahram Peaks  
- Extraction requires surviving:
  - The Rahzakar Dunes  
  - Burrowing sand predators  
  - Extreme environmental heat  
  - Violent territorial creatures  

---

## Quote
*"It remembers every drop of blood that fed its fire."*

entries.title: Voidsteel Ingot
entries.body:
# Voidsteel Ingot

## Effect
Voidsteel is a void-infused alloy forged through the fusion of High Steel and concentrated Void Essence. It suppresses energy, dulls surrounding presence, and destabilises magical structures through sheer entropic resonance.

---

## Appearance
Voidsteel appears as deep black metal fractured with faint violet lines that shift subtly beneath the surface. Rather than reflecting light, the metal seems to consume it, leaving edges blurred and difficult to focus on directly.

When exposed to magical energy, the fractures pulse faintly like cracks in empty space.

---

## Lore
Voidsteel was first forged within the Gloomforges after the fracturing of the Seal of Gloom. By binding Void Essence into High Steel, ancient smiths created a material capable of resisting reality itself.

Unlike other dark-aligned materials, Voidsteel does not feed on death or shadow — it erodes structure, stability, and existence through gradual entropic pressure.

Forging Voidsteel is exceptionally dangerous, as improperly stabilised alloys may collapse into unstable void fractures.

---

## Material Traits
- Suppresses surrounding magical energy  
- Resistant to magical destabilisation  
- Maintains integrity under void pressure  
- Difficult for weaker enchantments to stabilise against  

---

## Alloy Composition
- High Steel  
- Void Essence  
- Gloomforge refinement process  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Dark**  
- Enhances:
  - Entropy effects  
  - Suppression enchantments  
  - Void-aligned abilities  
- Weak interaction with Life and Light-aligned enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +4 Armor Modifier  
- Favours void, suppression, and anti-magic combat styles  

---

## Special Interaction
- Weakens unstable magical structures over time  
- Performs best against magic-heavy opponents  
- Dampens surrounding magical resonance in prolonged combat  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires High Steel  
- Requires Void Essence  
- Must be forged within a Gloomforge or void-aligned forge  

---

## Quote
*"It is not darkness — it is what remains when reality begins to fail."*

entries.title: Mythril Ingot
entries.body:
# Mythril Ingot

## Effect
Mythril is a refined celestial metal prized for its balance of lightness, durability, and magical conductivity. It allows weapons and armor to remain exceptionally agile without sacrificing structural integrity.

---

## Appearance
Mythril Ingots possess a luminous silver-blue finish with a polished surface that reflects light softly rather than sharply.

Under moonlight or magical energy, faint silver radiance moves beneath the metal like flowing mist.

---

## Lore
For centuries, Mythril has been regarded as one of the greatest metals ever discovered by mortal smiths. Entire kingdoms built their elite relics, armor, and enchanted weapons from it due to its unmatched versatility.

Many ancient orders considered Mythril sacred, believing the metal carried traces of celestial harmony within its structure.

---

## Material Traits
- Lightweight and highly durable  
- Excellent mana conductivity  
- Maintains enchantments with exceptional stability  
- Resistant to magical degradation and corruption  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Air** and **Light**  
- Enhances:
  - Speed and agility enchantments  
  - Mana efficiency  
  - Precision and refinement effects  
- Performs exceptionally well with enchanted equipment  

---

## Combat Integration
- +4 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours agile, refined, and magic-enhanced combat styles  

---

## Special Interaction
- Reduces burden and movement restriction when used in armor  
- Stabilises magical enchantments more effectively than most metals  
- Performs exceptionally well in prolonged magical use  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Mythril Ore]]  
- Requires refined forge conditions and precise temperature control  

---

## Quote
*"The finest metals do not weigh the bearer down — they let them rise."*

entries.title: Netherite Ingot
entries.body:
# Netherite Ingot

## Effect
Netherite is a powerful infernal metal infused with destructive heat and corruptive energy. It amplifies aggression, domination, and sustained offensive force while resisting weakening effects from holy or light-aligned sources.

---

## Appearance
Netherite Ingots are blackened crimson metal with glowing magma-like fractures beneath the surface. The metal absorbs surrounding light unevenly, creating the impression of burning darkness contained within solid form.

When exposed to combat or infernal energy, the internal glow intensifies.

---

## Lore
Netherite became infamous during the infernal wars, where abyssal forgemasters refined the ore into weapons capable of overwhelming both mortal armies and celestial forces.

Unlike ordinary infernal materials, Netherite does not merely burn — it corrupts and dominates, exerting pressure on both the body and will of its wielder.

Many legendary cursed weapons were forged from Netherite due to its affinity for domination and destructive power.

---

## Material Traits
- Retains infernal heat and aggression  
- Resistant to fire and corruption  
- Difficult to weaken through holy energy  
- Can gradually influence unstable wielders  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Fire** and **Dark**  
- Enhances:
  - Infernal enchantments  
  - Corruption effects  
  - Aggressive combat abilities  
- Weak interaction with Light and purification enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +4 Armor Modifier  
- Favours aggressive, domination, and infernal combat styles  

---

## Special Interaction
- Performs best during prolonged combat  
- Resonates strongly with infernal environments or entities  
- Exposure to infernal flame can temporarily strengthen the material  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Netherite Ore]]  
- Requires infernal forge or abyssal flame refinement  

---

## Quote
*"It does not ask for obedience — it demands it."*

entries.title: Orichalcum Ingot
entries.body:
# Orichalcum Ingot

## Effect
Orichalcum is a sacred divine metal renowned for its ability to channel radiant energy, divine flame, and holy power with exceptional stability.

Weapons and armor forged from Orichalcum are often regarded as relics rather than equipment due to the metal’s purity and celestial resonance.

---

## Appearance
Orichalcum Ingots possess a radiant golden-red metallic surface with soft inner illumination flowing beneath the metal like liquid sunlight.

Under intense light or divine energy, the ingot shines with a warm solar glow.

---

## Lore
Throughout history, Orichalcum has been associated with divine kingdoms, celestial champions, and sacred relic forges.

Ancient forge masters believed the metal carried remnants of the first dawn within its structure, making it one of the few materials capable of enduring immense holy power without instability.

Many legendary relics wielded by paladins, high priests, and divine guardians were forged from Orichalcum.

---

## Material Traits
- Exceptional divine energy conductivity  
- Resistant to corruption and decay  
- Stable under intense radiant or holy energy  
- Difficult to shape without celestial forge conditions  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Fire** and **Light**  
- Enhances:
  - Radiant enchantments  
  - Blessings and purification effects  
  - Holy flame abilities  
- Weak interaction with Dark and corruption-based enchantments  

---

## Combat Integration
- +5 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours paladins, divine casters, relic weapons, and holy guardians  

---

## Special Interaction
- Performs exceptionally well under sunlight or divine influence  
- Naturally suppresses weak corruption and curses  
- Resonates strongly with holy relics and sacred locations  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Orichalcum Ore]]  
- Requires celestial forge or divine flame refinement conditions  

---

## Quote
*"It is not merely forged by light — it remembers the first dawn."*

entries.title: Starite Ingot
entries.body:
# Starite Ingot

## Effect
Starite is a refined astral metal renowned for its exceptional mana conductivity and celestial resonance. It channels magical energy with remarkable stability, making it highly sought after for advanced spellcraft, relic forging, and planar devices.

---

## Appearance
Starite Ingots possess a polished silver-blue finish filled with shifting prismatic reflections resembling a moving night sky.

Under magical energy, faint constellations and flowing star-like patterns appear beneath the surface.

---

## Lore
Throughout history, Starite has been associated with celestial observatories, astral forges, and ancient mage civilizations that studied the movement of the heavens.

Because of its affinity with mana flow and astral resonance, many legendary staffs, relics, and planar mechanisms were forged using Starite as their core material.

Some scholars believe the metal subtly responds to the movement of stars and ley lines across the world.

---

## Material Traits
- Exceptional mana conductivity  
- Stable under planar and astral energy exposure  
- Resistant to magical degradation  
- Performs exceptionally well in magical constructs and relics  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Light** and **Air**  
- Enhances:
  - Mana-channeling  
  - Astral and teleportation effects  
  - Spell stability and refinement  
- Performs exceptionally well in arcane focuses and relics  

---

## Combat Integration
- +4 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours mages, astral casters, relic weapons, and advanced magical constructs  

---

## Special Interaction
- Resonates strongly near ley lines and celestial phenomena  
- Improves magical stability during prolonged spellcasting  
- Can subtly react to astral or planar disturbances  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Starite Ore]]  
- Requires astral forge or celestial refinement conditions  

---

## Quote
*"Every fragment remembers the sky it fell from."*

entries.title: Vibranium Ingot
entries.body:
# Vibranium Ingot

## Effect
Vibranium is a resonant metal capable of absorbing, storing, and redirecting kinetic energy through harmonic vibration.

Weapons and armor forged from Vibranium excel at dispersing force, reducing impact strain, and converting movement into stored resonance energy.

---

## Appearance
Vibranium Ingots possess a smooth dark silver finish with subtle blue-white resonance veins beneath the surface.

When impacted, the metal emits a deep harmonic tone while faint pulses of light ripple across the ingot.

---

## Lore
Vibranium became legendary among advanced artificers and resonance smiths due to its unique ability to interact with force itself.

Unlike traditional defensive metals that rely purely on hardness, Vibranium survives through controlled energy redistribution, allowing it to withstand devastating impacts that would shatter ordinary materials.

Many ancient resonance forges considered Vibranium a “living metal,” claiming it slowly adapted to repeated combat stresses over time.

---

## Material Traits
- Absorbs and redistributes kinetic force  
- Highly resistant to blunt impacts and shattering  
- Resonates with movement and vibration  
- Performs exceptionally well in reactive systems and advanced constructs  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with **Air**  
- Enhances:
  - Resonance enchantments  
  - Shockwave and vibration effects  
  - Movement and reaction-based abilities  
- Stable under prolonged magical stress  

---

## Combat Integration
- +4 Damage Modifier  
- +5 Armor Modifier  
- Favours reactive, defensive, and artificer-based combat styles  

---

## Special Interaction
- Performs exceptionally well under repeated impacts  
- Can store resonance energy temporarily  
- Resonates with movement, sound, and kinetic force  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Vibranium Ore]]  
- Requires harmonic forge or resonance-controlled refinement  

---

## Quote
*"Strength fades after impact — resonance endures."*

entries.title: Primordrite Ingot
entries.body:
# Primordrite Ingot

## Effect
Primordrite is a relic-grade creation metal tied directly to the foundational energies of existence itself. It exists in perfect harmony with elemental, magical, and spiritual forces, allowing it to channel and stabilise immense power without degradation.

---

## Appearance
Primordrite Ingots possess a constantly shifting metallic surface that never fully settles into a single colour. Waves of radiant gold, deep crimson, silver-white, ocean blue, and void-black flow slowly beneath the metal like living energy.

Under strong magical influence, the ingot emits a low resonant hum resembling a distant heartbeat.

---

## Lore
Primordrite is considered one of the rarest and oldest materials in existence. Ancient records describe it as “the first metal” — a substance formed when creation itself solidified into physical form.

Only fragments of Primordrite are known to exist, often hidden within relic vaults, celestial ruins, or locations scarred by primordial events.

Many legendary relics, realm-binding constructs, and divine artifacts are believed to contain traces of Primordrite within their core structure.

---

## Material Traits
- Harmonises all elemental and magical forces  
- Resistant to corruption, decay, and magical destabilisation  
- Stable under immense reality-altering pressure  
- Exceptionally difficult to forge or shape  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Perfect affinity with all elemental alignments  
- Enhances:
  - Relic-grade enchantments  
  - Elemental harmony  
  - Mana stability  
  - Creation and binding effects  
- Performs exceptionally well in relics and world-tier artifacts  

---

## Combat Integration
- +6 Damage Modifier  
- +6 Armor Modifier  
- Favours relic weapons, divine artifacts, and primordial constructs  

---

## Special Interaction
- Stabilises conflicting magical forces  
- Resonates strongly near primordial energy or realm fractures  
- Can maintain enchantments that would destabilise ordinary materials  

---

## Crafting Source
- Requires 4x [[Primordrite Ore]]  
- Requires primordial forge or relic-grade creation forge conditions  

---

## Quote
*"It was not forged to survive the world — it was forged before the world existed."*

entries.title: Antimony Ore
entries.body:
# Antimony Ore

## Effect
Antimony Ore is a brittle, crystalline metal-bearing ore that enhances hardness and structural integrity when alloyed. It is rarely used alone but is critical in reinforcing softer metals.

---

## Lore
Known as the *“Bone of the Earth,”* antimony was believed by ancient smiths to give metals their “spine.” While fragile in isolation, it grants resilience to those it strengthens.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Brittle and unstable in raw form  
- Breaks easily under stress  
- Essential for strengthening alloys  
- Requires careful refinement  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Antimony Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Fragile structure leads to material loss if overheated

---

## Alloy Use
- [[Pewter Ingot]]
- Future reinforced alloys

---

## Enchantment Use
- Slightly improves structural stability of enchanted items  
- Helps prevent deformation under magical stress  

---

## Quote
*"It does not endure — it ensures that others do."*

entries.title: Copper Ore
entries.body:
# Copper Ore

## Effect
Copper Ore contains trace conductive veins that respond strongly to heat and energy. When refined, it produces a metal highly suited for elemental channeling and early enchantment work.

---

## Lore
Known as the *“First Flame Ore,”* copper was the first material mortals learned to draw from the earth and shape with fire. It represents the birth of craft and the beginning of all metallurgy.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Easily mined and refined  
- High impurity content → refinement loss  
- Strong elemental conductivity (Fire / Lightning)  
- Core material for early crafting systems  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Copper Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Standard impurity loss during smelting

---

## Alloy Use
- [[Bronze Ingot]]
- [[Brass Ingot]]

---

## Enchantment Use
- Enhances low-tier elemental enchantments  
- Improves mana flow in crafted items  

---

## Quote
*"From the earth’s spark, all craft begins."*

entries.title: Gold Ore
entries.body:
# Gold Ore

## Effect
Gold Ore is rich in magical conductivity, making it one of the most valuable materials for enchantment despite its softness.

---

## Lore
Known as the *“Tears of the Dawn,”* gold is believed to be crystallised sunlight buried within the earth.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Rare and valuable  
- Soft and easily refined  
- Highly magical  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Gold Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot

---

## Alloy Use
- [[Sunsteel]] (future)
- Reinforcement alloys

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional for divine and celestial magic  
- Stabilises high-tier enchantments  

---

## Quote
*"Gold does not fade — it remembers the light."*

entries.title: Iron Ore
entries.body:
# Iron Ore

## Effect
Iron Ore is dense and impurity-rich, requiring proper smelting to unlock its strength. Once refined, it forms the backbone of most weapons and armor.

---

## Lore
Called the *“Blood of the World,”* iron runs deep beneath the earth. Civilizations rose and fell by their ability to mine and shape it.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Dense and widely available  
- Requires stronger heat to refine  
- Reliable base material for combat equipment  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Iron Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Requires stable heat for proper refinement

---

## Alloy Use
- [[Steel Ingot]]

---

## Enchantment Use
- Neutral magical properties  
- Supports basic rune and enchantment structures  

---

## Quote
*"From stone and fire, strength is born."*

entries.title: Lead Ore
entries.body:
# Lead Ore

## Effect
Lead Ore absorbs magical energy, making it valuable for anti-magic crafting and containment.

---

## Lore
Called the *“Veil Stone,”* lead is said to silence magic itself.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Dense and heavy  
- Toxic if mishandled  
- Used in containment crafting  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Lead Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot

---

## Alloy Use
- Anti-magic alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- Suppresses magic  
- Blocks magical detection  

---

## Quote
*"Where magic ends, lead remains."*

entries.title: Nickel Ore
entries.body:
# Nickel Ore

## Effect
Nickel Ore contains balanced metallic properties that allow it to stabilise and reinforce other materials when refined and alloyed. It is rarely used alone but is essential in improving durability and magical consistency.

---

## Lore
Known as the *“Silent Binder,”* nickel was long overlooked until master smiths discovered its ability to unify stronger metals without weakening them. It is said to be the metal that prevents failure before it happens.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Moderate density and durability  
- Resistant to corrosion  
- Stabilises alloy structures  
- Commonly found near iron deposits  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Nickel Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Stable refinement with low material loss

---

## Alloy Use
- Reinforcement alloys
- Stability-focused metals

---

## Enchantment Use
- Improves enchantment stability  
- Reduces failure or backlash in enchanted items  

---

## Quote
*"It is not seen in the blade — but without it, the blade fails."*

entries.title: Silver Ore
entries.body:
# Silver Ore

## Effect
Silver Ore carries strong spiritual resonance, making it ideal for crafting anti-entity and divine-aligned materials.

---

## Lore
Known as *“Moon-Touched Stone,”* silver is said to form where celestial light touches the earth.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Rare compared to other common metals  
- High magical purity  
- Used in sacred crafting  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Silver Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot

---

## Alloy Use
- Often combined with stronger metals for weapons

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with Light and Spirit magic  
- Effective against undead and cursed beings  

---

## Quote
*"Where light lingers, silver forms."*

entries.title: Tin Ore
entries.body:
# Tin Ore

## Effect
Tin Ore is a soft, low-density material with minimal standalone use, but it plays a crucial role in stabilising alloys and enabling stronger metal compositions.

---

## Lore
Called the *“Silent Catalyst,”* tin lacks strength but enables greatness in others. Entire ages of advancement depended on its quiet presence in alloy crafting.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Very soft and easy to refine  
- High impurity loss during smelting  
- Essential for alloy creation  
- Common training material  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Tin Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: High loss due to impurities

---

## Alloy Use
- [[Bronze Ingot]]

---

## Enchantment Use
- Minimal direct use  
- Stabilises enchantments in alloys  

---

## Quote
*"It does not shine — but it makes others stronger."*

entries.title: Zinc Ore
entries.body:
# Zinc Ore

## Effect
Zinc Ore is a reactive and volatile material that plays a critical role in alloy creation. While weak on its own, it enhances flexibility, resonance, and thermal response when combined with other metals.

---

## Lore
Known as the *“Breath of the Forge,”* zinc was discovered not for its strength, but for how it transformed other metals. Ancient artificers prized it for its ability to “awaken” dormant properties within alloys.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Low structural strength  
- Highly reactive when heated  
- Vaporises at high temperatures if mishandled  
- Essential for alloy crafting  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Zinc Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Requires controlled heat to prevent material loss

---

## Alloy Use
- [[Brass Ingot]]

---

## Enchantment Use
- Minimal direct use  
- Enhances resonance in alloys  

---

## Quote
*"It is not the strength of zinc, but what it awakens in others."*

entries.title: Aluminum Ore
entries.body:
# Aluminum Ore

## Effect
Aluminum Ore is unusually light and responsive to energy, making it valuable for crafting materials focused on speed, movement, and agility.

---

## Lore
Often called *“Sky Ore,”* aluminum is believed to form in regions touched by high winds or lightning storms. Ancient artificers sought it to craft tools that defied weight and gravity.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Extremely lightweight compared to other ores  
- Difficult to extract without loss due to fragility  
- Highly resistant to corrosion  
- Found in high-altitude or storm-rich regions  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Aluminum Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Requires controlled heat to prevent material degradation

---

## Alloy Use
- Lightweight alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with Air and Lightning magic  
- Enhances speed and movement-based effects  

---

## Quote
*"Light as wind, fleeting as a storm."*

entries.title: Chromium Ore
entries.body:
# Chromium Ore

## Effect
Chromium Ore yields a highly stable metal known for its resistance to corrosion and structural reinforcement. It is essential in crafting advanced alloys that require durability and longevity.

---

## Lore
Known as the *“Shield Vein”* of the earth, chromium was first discovered in mineral deposits untouched by rust or decay. Smiths quickly realised its value — not for power, but for endurance.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Highly resistant to corrosion and environmental damage  
- Reinforces structural integrity of alloys  
- Stable during high-temperature refinement  
- Often found near iron-rich deposits  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Chromium Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Produces a clean, stable refined metal with minimal impurity loss

---

## Alloy Use
- [[High Steel Ingot]]

---

## Enchantment Use
- Improves durability of enchanted items  
- Helps prevent degradation under repeated magical use  

---

## Quote
*"It does not break — it prevents breaking."*****

entries.title: Platinum Ore
entries.body:
# Platinum Ore

## Effect
Platinum Ore contains highly pure metallic veins that conduct magical energy with exceptional stability, making it one of the most valuable refinement materials for enchantment-focused crafting.

---

## Lore
Known as the *“Metal of Divinity,”* platinum is said to form where celestial energy seeps into the earth. Some believe it is the crystallised essence of fallen stars.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- High purity with minimal impurities  
- Extremely difficult to extract and refine  
- Resistant to corruption and decay  
- Found in deep or magically saturated environments  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Platinum Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Requires advanced or stable forge conditions

---

## Alloy Use
- High-tier alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with Light and Celestial magic  
- Maintains enchantment stability under heavy use  

---

## Quote
*"From the heavens it fell — and to the heavens it answers."*

entries.title: Cobalt Ore
entries.body:
# Cobalt Ore

## Effect
Cobalt Ore is infused with latent arcane energy, allowing it to conduct and amplify mana when refined. It serves as a key material for enchantment-focused metals and arcane equipment.

---

## Lore
Deep within storm-touched mountains, cobalt forms where lightning and stone meet. Ancient smiths believed it to be a “sleeping metal,” awakened only through magic and heat.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Naturally conductive to magical energy  
- Stable under high-temperature refinement  
- Resistant to arcane degradation  
- Often found near lightning-rich or mana-dense regions  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Cobalt Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Responds well to magically stabilised forges

---

## Alloy Use
- Advanced enchantment alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- Enhances Lightning and Ice magic  
- Improves mana flow in crafted items  

---

## Quote
*"Within the stone sleeps the storm."*

entries.title: Thorium Ore
entries.body:
# Thorium Ore

## Effect
Thorium Ore radiates stored arcane energy, making it highly reactive during refinement. When properly processed, it produces a metal capable of storing and releasing magical power.

---

## Lore
Forged in the deep veins of the world where lightning once struck the earth’s core, thorium is known as the *“Metal of Living Light.”* It is both revered and feared for its raw power.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Emits low levels of magical radiation  
- Extremely dense and heat-resistant  
- Difficult to mine and handle safely  
- Requires skilled refinement to stabilise  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Thorium Ingot]]
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
- Notes: Requires controlled environment to prevent instability

---

## Alloy Use
- High-tier magical alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with Radiant and Arcane magic  
- Stores residual magical energy  

---

## Quote
*"Power sleeps in its veins — waiting to be awakened."*

entries.title: Bismuth Ore
entries.body:
# Bismuth Ore

## Effect
Bismuth Ore forms in unstable crystalline structures that react unpredictably to magical and environmental input. It carries volatile energy that can either amplify or distort magical effects.

---
## Appearance
Bismuth Ore forms in jagged, geometric clusters with sharp, stepped edges that resemble fractured crystal structures. Its surface displays shifting iridescent colours — purples, blues, greens, and golds — that change depending on the angle of light.

The edges of the ore appear unstable, subtly warping or realigning when viewed from different perspectives, as if the structure is never fully fixed.

---
## Lore
Bismuth is born in places where magic fractures reality — wild magic zones, broken ley lines, and unstable rifts. Its crystalline patterns constantly shift, reflecting a world that refuses to remain still.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Crystalline metallic structure  
- Unstable under sustained stress  
- Difficult to refine without loss  
- Found in high-risk magical environments  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Bismuth Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Notes: Refinement may produce unstable or imperfect ingots if not carefully controlled  

---

## Alloy Use
- Chaos-based alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- Very high affinity with volatile and chaotic magic  
- Amplifies power but reduces stability  
- Can cause unpredictable magical interactions  

---

## Quote
*"It does not obey — it reacts."*

entries.title: Dark Silver Ore
entries.body:
# Dark Silver Ore

## Effect
Dark Silver Ore is infused with the primordial essence of **Dark itself** — not death, but absence, depth, and shadow. It absorbs light and distorts magical energy, forming a metal that thrives in low-light environments.

---
## Appearance
Dark Silver Ore appears as smooth, shadow-toned metal veined through stone, with a muted, almost matte finish that absorbs surrounding light. Its surface reflects very little, giving it a depth that feels more like a void than a solid material.

In low light, faint ripples of darker shade seem to move across the ore, as though shadows are pooling and shifting within it rather than around it.

---
## Lore
Dark Silver was not mined — it was *formed*. In places where light was stripped away completely, the essence of Dark condensed into physical form. It is neither evil nor corrupt, but a reflection of balance — the quiet counterpart to Light.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Absorbs ambient light and magical energy  
- Strengthens in darkness and shadow-rich environments  
- Naturally dampens radiant and light-based effects  
- Stable during refinement despite its unusual origin  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Dark Silver Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Notes: Best refined in low-light or magically controlled environments  

---

## Alloy Use
- Dark-aligned alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- High affinity with **Dark** magic  
- Supports shadow manipulation and concealment effects  
- Reduces stability of Light-based enchantments  

---

## Quote
*"It is not the absence of light — it is what remains when light leaves."*

entries.title: Moonstone Ore
entries.body:
# Moonstone Ore

## Effect
Moonstone Ore carries lunar resonance, shifting subtly in response to light cycles and magical presence. It stabilises and harmonises magical energy rather than amplifying or suppressing it.

---
## Appearance
Moonstone Ore appears as pale, semi-translucent stone veined with soft silver and faint blue hues. It emits a gentle, diffused glow that subtly brightens and dims, as if responding to an unseen cycle.

Within the ore, faint patterns resembling drifting light or slow-moving ripples can be seen, giving the impression that the material is quietly alive with lunar energy.

---
## Lore
Moonstone forms where celestial light meets the physical world in cycles — waxing and waning with unseen forces. It is said to reflect not just the moon above, but the balance between Light and Dark within the world itself.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Responds to ambient light and magical cycles  
- Stabilises fluctuating magical energy  
- Maintains structural integrity under magical stress  
- Often found in regions touched by celestial influence  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Moonstone Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Notes: Refinement is most stable under controlled or natural light cycles  

---

## Alloy Use
- Celestial or arcane-balanced alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- High affinity with **Celestial and Arcane** magic  
- Stabilises multi-effect enchantments  
- Reduces magical volatility  

---

## Quote
*"It does not choose a side — it reflects them both."*

entries.title: Pure Silver Ore
entries.body:
# Pure Silver Ore

## Effect
Pure Silver Ore is infused with the essence of **Light itself** — not life, but clarity, purity, and illumination. It emits a faint glow and disrupts shadow and corruption.

---
## Appearance
Pure Silver Ore appears as bright, pale metal veins running through stone, noticeably cleaner and more luminous than common silver. Its surface reflects light with a soft, steady glow, giving it an almost pristine, untouched quality.

Even in low light, the ore maintains a faint brightness, as though holding onto light rather than reflecting it.

---
## Lore
Unlike common silver, Pure Silver is not simply refined — it is *formed*. Where Light condenses into the physical world, veins of Pure Silver emerge, untouched by impurity. It is said to be the metal that Light chose to inhabit.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Emits a faint glow in darkness  
- Naturally repels corruption and shadow  
- Sensitive to impurity during refinement  
- Requires precise heat control to maintain purity  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Pure Silver Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Notes: Overheating reduces purity and effectiveness  

---

## Alloy Use
- Light-aligned alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- High affinity with **Light** magic  
- Enhances purification and illumination effects  
- Reduces effectiveness of Dark-aligned enchantments  

---

## Quote
*"It does not shine — it reveals."*

entries.title: Quicksilver Ore
entries.body:
# Quicksilver Ore

## Effect
Quicksilver Ore appears to flow and ripple despite remaining solid. It reacts instantly to movement, temperature, and magical presence, making it one of the most responsive metals found in the world.

---
## Appearance
Quicksilver Ore has a smooth, mirror-like surface that appears to ripple as if liquid, even when completely still. Light bends across it in unnatural ways, creating shifting reflections that never fully match the environment.

When disturbed, the surface briefly “flows” before settling again, as though the metal is reacting to movement rather than being moved by it.

---
## Lore
Quicksilver forms in regions where reality is unstable — areas touched by shifting leylines, arcane storms, or spatial distortion. It is said that the metal never chose a fixed state, existing between motion and stillness.

Ancient artificers believed it to be a “thinking metal,” capable of responding to the intent of its wielder before action is taken.

---
## Material & Crafting Traits
- Appears fluid but maintains a solid structure  
- Extremely responsive to external stimuli  
- Difficult to stabilise during mining and transport  
- Found in magically unstable or high-energy regions  

---
## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Quicksilver Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Notes: Requires controlled refinement to prevent instability  

---
## Alloy Use
- Adaptive alloys (future system)

---
## Enchantment Use
- High affinity with **Water** and **Air** essences  
- Enhances:
  - Flow-based movement  
  - Speed and reaction effects  
  - Adaptive enchantments  

---

## Quote
*"It does not flow — it chooses to move."*

entries.title: Tungsten Ore
entries.body:
# Tungsten Ore

## Effect
Tungsten Ore is one of the densest and most heat-resistant materials found in the mortal world. It provides unmatched structural strength but offers little natural affinity for magic.

---
## Appearance
Tungsten Ore appears as dark, dense rock threaded with dull grey metallic veins. Unlike most ores, it has very little shine, instead absorbing light and giving off a heavy, matte presence.

The metal within the stone looks compact and tightly packed, with almost no visible impurities, as if compressed under immense pressure deep within the earth.

---
## Lore
Deep within the earth, far below ordinary mining veins, tungsten forms under immense pressure and heat. Dwarven records call it *“The Bones of the World,”* a material that does not bend, yield, or forget.

---

## Material & Crafting Traits
- Extremely dense and heavy  
- Highly resistant to heat and pressure  
- Difficult to mine and refine  
- Requires advanced or high-temperature forging methods  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Tungsten Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Notes: Requires extreme heat or specialised forge conditions  

---

## Alloy Use
- High-density reinforcement alloys (future)

---

## Enchantment Use
- Low affinity with magic  
- Best used for physical durability over magical enhancement  

---

## Quote
*"It was not made to move — only to endure."*

entries.title: Arricallium Ore
entries.body:
# Arricallium Ore

## Effect
Arricallium Ore is a naturally occurring metal infused with raw energy, allowing it to conduct and stabilise magical flow with exceptional efficiency.

---

## Appearance
Arricallium Ore appears as a dark metallic stone threaded with glowing veins of electric blue and faint orange light. These veins pulse intermittently, as if carrying energy through the material.

When exposed to magical sources, the glow intensifies and spreads across the surface.

---

## Lore
Arricallium forms in areas where intense energy interacts with the natural world — often near leyline intersections, storm-scarred regions, or sites of magical convergence.

Unlike most metals, it is born already attuned to energy, making it highly sought after by artificers and spellcasters.

---

## Material Traits
- Naturally conducts magical energy  
- Stable under magical strain  
- Difficult to mine safely due to energy discharge  
- Reacts to nearby magical activity  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Arricallium Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Requires energy-stabilised forge  

---

## Enchantment Use
- High affinity with **Air** and **Fire**  
- Enhances:
  - Energy flow  
  - Spellcasting stability  
  - Channeling effects  

---

## Quote
*"It does not hold power — it lets it flow."*v

entries.title: Duranium Ore
entries.body:
# Duranium Ore

## Effect
Duranium Ore is a dense, energy-reactive metal that forms in regions of extreme pressure and force. It naturally absorbs and stabilises incoming energy, making it highly resilient to both physical and environmental stress.

---

## Appearance
Duranium Ore appears as a dark grey metallic stone with faint, shifting patterns beneath its surface. These patterns move slowly, like energy being redistributed through the material.

When struck, subtle ripples travel across the ore before fading.

---

## Lore
Duranium forms deep beneath the surface of the world or within areas of intense energy convergence. These environments compress and fuse energy into physical form, creating a metal that responds to force rather than resisting it.

It is rare and difficult to extract due to its density and reactive nature.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely dense and heavy  
- Absorbs and redistributes energy  
- Stable under high pressure and force  
- Difficult to mine and transport  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Duranium Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Requires high-energy or pressure-stable forge  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Moderate affinity with **Earth** and **Air**  
- Enhances:
  - Stability  
  - Defensive effects  
  - Energy control  

---

## Quote
*"It does not break — it changes how the world strikes it."*

entries.title: Ebony Ore
entries.body:
# Ebony Ore

## Effect
Ebony Ore is a naturally occurring shadow-infused metal that absorbs light and ambient energy. It suppresses presence and reduces magical visibility, making it ideal for stealth and concealment.

---

## Appearance
Ebony Ore appears as deep black stone with a matte surface that absorbs surrounding light. Faint violet undertones can be seen within its structure when exposed to magical energy.

Its edges seem to blur slightly in low light, as though the material is partially merging with shadow.

---

## Lore
Ebony forms deep within the Netherworld and other shadow-aligned regions, where light cannot reach and death energy accumulates over time.

It is often associated with ancient entities and forgotten places, and those who mine it report an unnatural silence surrounding the material.

---

## Material Traits
- Absorbs light and ambient energy  
- Dampens sound and presence  
- Stable under shadow and death energy  
- Difficult to detect in low-light environments  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Ebony Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Requires shadow-aligned forge or controlled environment  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Strong affinity with **Dark** and **Death**  
- Enhances:
  - Stealth effects  
  - Energy drain  
  - Suppression abilities  

---

## Quote
*"Where light ends, it begins."*

entries.title: Adamantium Ore
entries.body:
# Adamantium Ore

## Effect
Adamantium Ore is one of the densest and most resilient materials known. Formed under immense pressure deep beneath the world or within the remains of collapsed stars, it possesses extraordinary structural stability.

---

## Appearance
Adamantium Ore appears as dark grey-black stone threaded with dense metallic veins. Its surface is rough and matte, but when struck, faint silver reflections emerge beneath the stone.

The ore feels unnaturally heavy, even in small quantities.

---

## Lore
Adamantium Ore forms only under impossible pressure and heat, either deep within the earth or in locations touched by the remnants of fallen celestial bodies.

Ancient civilizations believed the metal was the foundation of mountains themselves, and many legendary fortresses were said to be built around Adamantium deposits rather than mined from them.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely dense and difficult to move  
- Resistant to physical and environmental degradation  
- Maintains structural integrity under immense force  
- Nearly impossible to refine using standard methods  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Adamantium Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Requires divine-grade or deep-earth forge conditions  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Moderate affinity with **Earth**  
- Enhances:
  - Reinforcement  
  - Durability  
  - Stability enchantments  
- Difficult to shape for delicate magical refinement  

---

## Quote
*"Before kingdoms rose, it already endured."*

entries.title: Elementium Ore
entries.body:
# Elementium Ore

## Effect
Elementium Ore is a rare elemental metal formed where powerful ley lines and elemental forces converge. The ore naturally harmonises surrounding energies, allowing it to stabilise and conduct multiple elemental alignments simultaneously.

---

## Appearance
Elementium Ore appears as dark metallic stone threaded with shifting veins of elemental colour. These veins pulse softly and change depending on the surrounding elemental environment.

Near fire the ore glows amber-red, while near water it shifts toward deep blue and silver tones.

---

## Lore
Elementium Ore forms in regions where elemental energy reaches perfect balance — ancient leyline nexuses, elemental convergence zones, or shattered locations touched by multiple realms.

Many scholars believe the material is not forged by the elements, but created by their agreement to coexist.

Fragments of Elementium can alter the surrounding ecosystem over time, slowly reshaping environments to reflect elemental balance.

---

## Material Traits
- Harmonises multiple elemental energies  
- Stable under magical stress  
- Conducts elemental mana efficiently  
- Slowly adapts to surrounding elemental environments  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Elementium Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot  
- Requires elemental convergence forge or astral forge conditions  

---

## Enchantment Use
- Exceptional affinity with elemental enchantments  
- Enhances:
  - Elemental harmony  
  - Mana stability  
  - Multi-element enchantments  

---

## Quote
*"The elements do not fight within it — they listen."*

entries.title: Meteorite Ore
entries.body:
# Meteorite Ore

## Effect
Meteorite Ore is a dense celestial material formed from fragments of fallen stars and cosmic bodies that survive atmospheric descent and impact with the world.

The ore carries immense internal compression and residual heat from its passage through the heavens.

---

## Appearance
Meteorite Ore appears as dark metallic stone streaked with burnt crimson and silver-grey veins. Portions of the surface appear partially melted or glassed over from atmospheric entry.

Small fragments often remain unnaturally warm long after impact.

---

## Lore
Meteorite Ore forms when celestial bodies survive their descent from the heavens and crash into the world with catastrophic force.

Many ancient civilizations viewed meteorites as omens, gifts from the stars, or weapons cast down by the gods. Entire wars have been fought over large impact sites due to the rarity and strength of the metal.

---

## Material Traits
- Extremely dense and impact-resistant  
- Retains residual celestial heat  
- Difficult to shape using standard forging methods  
- Stable under extreme pressure and force  

---

## Refinement
- Smelts into: [[Meteorite Ingot]]  
- Ratio: 4 Ore → 1 Ingot
